title: Unlock user account request body
description: Clears the locked_out flag and resets failed sign-in attempts; does not change the password. Call only after verify_security_answers returns success true for the same user_id; this endpoint does not re-verify. Do not wrap these fields in a request_body property; this schema describes the raw JSON body.

user_id.description: ServiceNow sys_user.sys_id returned by lookup_user_record and used in verify_security_answers. Do not generate or infer this value.
